title: nomux theme
description: A nomux theme file: values for the semantic design tokens of the nomux UI.

name.description: The name that the UI shows.

appearance.description: Whether the theme is light or dark. It must be equal to the appearance of the base theme.

extends.description: The identifier of the base theme: its file name without `.toml`. A token that this file does not set comes from the base theme.

tokens.description: The values of the tokens. Put each token name in quotes.

surface.sunken.description: The layout tone one step below the base. Use: Project rail and the track of a tab bar.

surface.base.description: The base tone of the window. Use: Sidebar, Pane content that is not a terminal (diff, file, timeline) and each region that has no other surface.

surface.button.description: Elevation level 1 (button): the flat fill of a control. Use: Buttons, shell chips of a tab bar, member chips of a team roster and input fields.

surface.raised.description: Elevation level 2 (raised): the tone of a container that holds controls. Use: The active Tab, the expanded card of the active sidebar row and the approval card.

surface.floating.description: Elevation level 3 (floating): the tone of a transient element above the layout. Use: Menus, the command palette, tooltips and hover previews. Only this level has a shadow.

text.primary.description: The text level with the most contrast. Use: Titles, the names of rows, the active Tab and the text of content.

text.secondary.description: The text level of items that are not active. Use: Tabs that are not active, chips and the letters of icons.

text.muted.description: The text level with the least contrast. It keeps a contrast of 4.5:1 without opacity. Use: Metadata after ` · `, Child work rows, hints and placeholders.

text.on-accent.description: The text on a fill of the accent colour. Use: The label of the primary button.

fill.hover.description: A neutral tint of `text.primary` (4% to 8%) that is painted over a surface. Use: The row, Tab or control below the pointer.

fill.selected.description: A neutral tint of `text.primary` (4% to 8%) that is painted over a surface. The text colour does not change. Use: The selected row and a pressed control.

line.hairline.description: A line colour with low alpha. Use: Separators between items in one region, where a tone step is not possible. Do not use it to put a box around a region.

line.divider.description: The line between two Panes. Use: Pane dividers. The divider gets the accent colour when the pointer is on it.

focus.ring.description: The colour of the keyboard focus indicator. Use: The ring around the control or the row that has the keyboard focus.

accent.description: The one accent colour of the theme. Use: The fill of the primary button, the indicator of the active Tab, the Pane divider below the pointer and the text cursor of an input field.

shadow.floating.description: The shadow colour of elevation level 3. Use: The shadow of menus, the command palette, tooltips and hover previews. The client sets the offset and the blur.

state.working.description: State colour blue: the agent works. Use: Status marks only: the mark of a row, a Tab, a project tile or a team member.

state.needs-you.description: State colour yellow: the agent waits for the user (permission, question or sign-in). Use: Status marks and the edge of the approval card. It is the only state that can pulse.

state.done.description: State colour green: the agent is done and the user did not read the result. Use: Status marks only.

state.error.description: State colour red: the agent or the Session stopped with an error. Use: Status marks, and the mark of a field that has an input error.

state.idle.description: State colour grey: the Session is idle. Use: Status marks only.

terminal.background.description: The default background of a terminal. Use: The cells of a terminal and the region around them in a terminal Tab.

terminal.foreground.description: The default text colour of a terminal. Use: Terminal text that has no ANSI colour.

terminal.cursor.description: The colour of the terminal cursor. Use: The cursor block, bar or underline of a terminal.

terminal.selection.description: The background of selected terminal text. Use: It is painted over the cell background. The text colour does not change.

terminal.ansi.black.description: ANSI colour 0. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 0.

terminal.ansi.red.description: ANSI colour 1. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 1.

terminal.ansi.green.description: ANSI colour 2. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 2.

terminal.ansi.yellow.description: ANSI colour 3. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 3.

terminal.ansi.blue.description: ANSI colour 4. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 4.

terminal.ansi.magenta.description: ANSI colour 5. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 5.

terminal.ansi.cyan.description: ANSI colour 6. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 6.

terminal.ansi.white.description: ANSI colour 7. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 7.

terminal.ansi.bright-black.description: ANSI colour 8. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 8.

terminal.ansi.bright-red.description: ANSI colour 9. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 9.

terminal.ansi.bright-green.description: ANSI colour 10. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 10.

terminal.ansi.bright-yellow.description: ANSI colour 11. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 11.

terminal.ansi.bright-blue.description: ANSI colour 12. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 12.

terminal.ansi.bright-magenta.description: ANSI colour 13. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 13.

terminal.ansi.bright-cyan.description: ANSI colour 14. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 14.

terminal.ansi.bright-white.description: ANSI colour 15. Use: Terminal cells that set colour 15.

diff.added.background.description: The background of an added line. It is painted over `surface.base`. Use: Added lines of a diff.

diff.added.gutter.description: The mark of an added line. Use: The gutter bar and the `+` sign of an added line.

diff.removed.background.description: The background of a removed line. It is painted over `surface.base`. Use: Removed lines of a diff.

diff.removed.gutter.description: The mark of a removed line. Use: The gutter bar and the `-` sign of a removed line.

diff.changed.background.description: The background of the changed part of a line. It is painted over `surface.base`. Use: The words that changed in a line, and a changed line in a file gutter.

diff.changed.gutter.description: The mark of a changed line. Use: The gutter bar of a changed line.

syntax.comment.description: Syntax role: comments. Use: Code in a diff, a file or a timeline.

syntax.keyword.description: Syntax role: keywords and operators that are words. Use: Code in a diff, a file or a timeline.

syntax.string.description: Syntax role: strings and characters. Use: Code in a diff, a file or a timeline.

syntax.constant.description: Syntax role: numbers, booleans and named constants. Use: Code in a diff, a file or a timeline.

syntax.function.description: Syntax role: names of functions and methods. Use: Code in a diff, a file or a timeline.

syntax.type.description: Syntax role: names of types. Use: Code in a diff, a file or a timeline.

font.ui.description: The one font family of the UI. Use: All text that is not code.

font.mono.description: The one monospace font family. Use: Terminals, diffs, files and code in a timeline.

font.title.size.description: Type scale: the size of a title. Use: The title row of a surface, and the title of a row or a Tab.

font.row.size.description: Type scale: the size of a row. Use: The second line of a row, body text and the labels of controls.

font.meta.size.description: Type scale: the size of metadata. Use: Metadata, counters and hints.

font.code.size.description: Type scale: the size of monospace text. Use: Terminals, diffs, files and code in a timeline.

line.width.description: The width of a line. Use: Hairlines and Pane dividers.

focus.ring-width.description: The width of the focus ring. Use: The ring around the control or the row that has the keyboard focus.

space.1.description: Spacing step 1 of the 4 px grid. Use: The gap between an icon or a mark and its label.

space.2.description: Spacing step 2 of the 4 px grid. Use: The gap between the items of a row and between controls.

space.3.description: Spacing step 3 of the 4 px grid. Use: The padding of a card and of a floating element.

space.4.description: Spacing step 4 of the 4 px grid. Use: The gap between the sections of a region, and the indent of one tree level.

density.comfortable.row-height.description: Comfortable density: the height of a row. Use: Sidebar rows and menu rows.

density.comfortable.control-height.description: Comfortable density: the height of a control. Use: Buttons, Tabs, chips and input fields.

density.comfortable.padding.description: Comfortable density: the horizontal padding. Use: The inner edges of rows, Tabs and controls.

density.compact.row-height.description: Compact density: the height of a row. Use: Sidebar rows and menu rows.

density.compact.control-height.description: Compact density: the height of a control. Use: Buttons, Tabs, chips and input fields.

density.compact.padding.description: Compact density: the horizontal padding. Use: The inner edges of rows, Tabs and controls.

size.icon.description: The one icon size of a row. Use: Icons in rows, Tabs, chips and buttons.

size.mark.description: The diameter of a status mark. Use: Status marks. A state does not change the size of the mark.

radius.button.description: The corner radius of elevation level 1. Use: Buttons, chips, Tabs, rows and input fields.

radius.raised.description: The corner radius of elevation level 2. Use: Cards.

radius.floating.description: The corner radius of elevation level 3. Use: Menus, the command palette, tooltips and hover previews.

font.title.weight.description: Type scale: the weight of a title. Use: The title row of a surface, and the title of a row or a Tab.

font.row.weight.description: Type scale: the weight of a row. Use: The second line of a row, body text and the labels of controls.

font.meta.weight.description: Type scale: the weight of metadata. Use: Metadata, counters and hints.

font.code.weight.description: Type scale: the weight of monospace text. Use: Terminals, diffs, files and code in a timeline.

motion.fast.description: The duration of a colour change, from 120 ms to 200 ms. Use: A state change of a mark, a hover fill and a selection fill.

motion.slow.description: The duration of a size change, from 120 ms to 200 ms. Use: A row that expands, a panel that opens and a Tab that moves.

motion.easing.description: The one easing of the UI: ease-out. Use: Each transition. Motion occurs only on a state change, and the client stops it when the user asks for reduced motion.

fontFamily.description: A list of font family names, the preferred family first.

fontWeight.description: A font weight. 400 is regular, 500 is medium.

easing.description: A cubic Bézier easing, as in CSS.
